description: This file defines the AfrDataPoint class, representing a data point for Air/Fuel ratio with associated engine parameters like RPM and engine load. It includes methods for creating data points based on engine parameters, indexing, and string representation.

classes.name: AfrDataPoint
classes.description: Represents an air/fuel ratio data point with engine parameters and indexing, providing methods for creation and access.

methods.name: AfrDataPoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing AFR data point with specified indices and values, performing validation.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Static factory method creating an AfrDataPoint instance from AFR, RPM, and engine load parameters.

methods.name: getRpm
methods.description: Returns the RPM value of the data point.

methods.name: getEngineLoad
methods.description: Returns the engine load value of the data point.

methods.name: getRpmIndex
methods.description: Returns the index corresponding to the RPM.

methods.name: getEngineLoadIndex
methods.description: Returns the index corresponding to the engine load.

methods.name: PRESS_RT_32
methods.description: Returns engine load index, possibly for real-time processing.

methods.name: RPM_RT_32
methods.description: Returns RPM index, possibly for real-time processing.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the data point.
